PASS on the fake backend (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); the package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null), no hardware was attached or run, and no human review or test is claimed.

WHAT IT SERVES: the card's models[0], task1_mujoco/robotiq_duo_full_scene_minimal_core/duo_full_scene_grasp.xml, is served as a configuration-only MujocoDriver in simulated mode R0 (device mhs://localhost/ebim-task1-cable-routing, kind world.sim). The card's entry symbol teleop.session:TeleopSession was confirmed at task1_mujoco/robotiq_duo_full_scene_minimal_core/teleop/session.py:43, and the model is the MuJoCo scene full_robot_board_cable_routing at duo_full_scene_grasp.xml:2. cap.world.step.v1 takes {ticks, action: {ctrl: [...]}}; the bridge derives each ctrl interval from the model's actuator_ctrlrange (28 actuators: the spine 0 to 0.85, base x/y -2.0 to 2.0 and yaw -4.0 to 4.0, FR3 arms -8 to 8, -10 to 10 and -12 to 12, grippers 0 to 0.8, caster and TMRV steer -3.14159 to 3.14159, roll and drive -80 to 80; duo_full_scene_grasp.xml:1030-1060) and refuses an out-of-range element before writing data.ctrl. cap.world.reset.v1 runs mj_resetData + mj_forward. The world state is the bridge's time_ms/qpos/qvel/ctrl/tick/timestep_ms/seed; the model timestep is 0.0005 s (duo_full_scene_grasp.xml:7), so timestep_ms is 0.5. No deviation from the card: family-config and the MujocoDriver helper express the real interface.

FAKE AND SIZES: MuJoCo is not installed or importable where the gate runs (no network, no pip), so backends['fake'] is this package's stand-in mujoco module (fake.py), the form the SDK's own MujocoDriver tests use. It parses the same MJCF for the explicitly declared joints, the 28 actuators, the per-actuator ctrlranges and the option timestep, then integrates a placeholder first-order motion. It is not MuJoCo: it resolves no contact, friction, equality, tendon, actuator gain, sensor or noise model, and it does not expand the composite cable. That cable is the one larger array: the 71-count composite with initial none expands (by MuJoCo's generator) to 70 segment bodies and 69 ball joints at 4 qpos and 3 qvel each (the target's own cable code reads qpos[qadr:qadr+4] at teleop/scene.py:113-121), so the real model's arrays are 315 qpos and 246 qvel, while the fake returns the 39 explicitly declared joints (39 qpos, 39 qvel); the fidelity gaps name this reduction. Real-render or real-array content is not returned because MuJoCo was never imported and no trajectory was compared with the engine. The real-engine backend (sim) was not run. The model file and its assets are read in place from the read-only clone and are never copied, imported or modified.

NOT COVERED: the MuJoCo engine and every trajectory-level behaviour; the composite cable's elasticity, twist/bend plugin and its 69 ball-joint dimensions in the fake; the upstream home-keyframe, cable-layout, ready-pose and spawn setup (session.py:53-57), because the bridge's reset applies mj_resetData only; the grasp servo, clip guide, cable speed cap and the rest of TeleopSession.step_once; the keyboard, gamepad, VR, GELLO and ROS 2 teleoperation layers; rendering, cameras, images and the 3DMax room; task scoring and the ManipetNet bridge; exact integration-state snapshot/restore (the stand-in has no mj_getState/mj_setState, so the bridge's fallback time/qpos/qvel/act/ctrl copy is used); and any physical robot or hardware run. The fake's reset also zeroes the arrays instead of resolving qpos0, which is marked # placeholder in fake.py.

WARNINGS AND LIMITS: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND are expected because backends['fake'] is the package's stand-in mujoco module object rather than a package class the gate can wrap in a Recorder; G8.NO_UNIT x3 is the family-derived ticks, action.ctrl[*] and reset seed inputs. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was raised. The package declares no Limit of its own and no operator-required bound: the only actuation bound is the model's ctrlrange, which the bridge derives from the file; ticks is bounded by the family's max_ticks. There is no site-limits.example.json and no catalogue_requests, because only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are used. test_driver.py keeps the check_driver call and adds six cases (model shape, per-actuator envelope refusals with zero effect, state following the control, reset, published fidelity contract and the e-stop latch); they pass. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package contract.
